current_point.claim: 基于四个真实世界中的大规模时序图数据集进行了大量实验，与目前主流的动态图表示学习方法相比，GSAERU模型的训练速度更快，消耗内存更少，同时性能与目前最好的算法相比差距不超过3.5%。
current_point.claim_en: Extensive experiments on four real-world large-scale sequential graph datasets showed that the GSAERU model has faster training speed, less memory consumption, and performance comparable to the best-performing algorithms with a gap not exceeding 3.5%.
